canonical_data: session transcripts, rewind points, task lists, configuration, and hooks under ~/.grok, plus the working tree
current_repo_note: Covers the open-source Grok Build CLI, TUI, and agent runtime. Grok the assistant, Grok Bot, the xAI API, and the community fork Open Grok are separate records.
strengths: Permission modes with allow, ask, and deny rules and hooks sit beside an optional Landlock and Seatbelt sandbox with named profiles and kernel-enforced deny lists
Sessions persist to disk with rewind points and can be resumed or compacted, and subagents run as child sessions with their own context
Interactive, headless, and Agent Client Protocol modes, MCP, skills, plugins, and custom model endpoints in three API styles make it embeddable
weaknesses: The public tree is a periodic sync from a private monorepo recorded in SOURCE_REV, and external contributions are not accepted

Default models are hosted by SpaceXAI and sign-in is through a vendor account, so data leaves the machine unless a custom endpoint is configured; terms for the released binary and account were not reviewable here
Sandboxing is off by default, and on macOS the profiles do not restrict child-process network access
Several tool implementations are ports of OpenAI Codex and OpenCode code, listed in third-party notices
why_it_matters: A lab-published coding agent whose runtime, permission layer, and sandbox are open to inspection, in a field where most vendor agents are closed.
